Recent work addressed multiple issues: removed unused legacy parser module, fixed Windows path handling in the --output flag (drive letters and backslashes were being mangled), and started implementing retry logic for network calls with exponential backoff (capped at three attempts). The export test has occasional random failures that were investigated but not fully resolved. Config validation was added to reject unknown keys.
